item.title: Ask HN: Who wants to be hired? (August 2026)
item.summary: Share your information if you are looking for work. Please use this format: Location: Remote: Willing to relocate: Technologies: Résumé/CV: Email: Please only post if you are personally looking for work. Agencies, recruiters, job boards, and so on, are off topic here. Readers: please only email these addresses to discuss work opportunities. Searchers: try https://nthesis.ai/public/hn-wants-to-be-hired , https://www.wantstobehired.com . Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49156682 Points: 3 # Comments: 33
